# Screenshot sample photos

These fictional coastal scenes are generated examples for the iOS Images to PDF
review and App Store captures. They contain no personal photographs. Created
with the built-in image generation tool on 8 November 2026 and resized to a
maximum dimension of 1000 pixels for use as test fixtures.

Prompts:

- A realistic landscape photograph of a coastal hiking trail winding toward
  distant cliffs and blue sea, in natural daylight, with no people or text.
- A portrait photograph of a leafy fern and sunlit wildflowers along a quiet
  coastal trail, in soft daylight, with no people or text.
